content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am working on a system that includes a [product_name] CPU and several [product_name] modules. All devices are linked through Ethernet, and I have programmed the CPU so that it triggers a communication error whenever one of the Ethernet cables is disconnected or fails. I haven't figured out how to make the modules show a similar error message in those scenarios. Does anyone have advice? Thanks, [user_name]

Hello, For [product_name], you can use the digital network input and set its properties for diagnostics. Additionally, you can configure the [product_name] display to show a message or toggle in the event a diagnostic error is detected. Hope this is helpful.
That's working perfectly! Thank you so much. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user aimed to mirror communication error diagnostics across several networked [company_name] automation devices. Guides on setting diagnostic error displays for [product_name] modules led to a quick and successful resolution.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects every networked [company_name] device to visibly show diagnostic messages for communication errors, matching the setup on their CPU module.
